name: xfuel-zk-circuits
description: ZK-SNARK circuits for XFuel Protocol bridge

scripts.setup:phase1: snarkjs groth16 setup build/deposit.r1cs powersOfTau28_hez_final_20.ptau build/circuit_0000.zkey
scripts.setup:phase2: snarkjs zkey contribute build/circuit_0000.zkey build/circuit_0001.zkey --name='XFuel Contributor 1' -e='random entropy'
scripts.export:vkey: snarkjs zkey export verificationkey build/circuit_final.zkey build/verification_key.json
scripts.build: npm run compile && npm run setup:phase1 && npm run setup:phase2 && npm run setup:beacon && npm run export:vkey && npm run export:solidity
scripts.copy:artifacts: cp build/deposit_js/deposit.wasm . && cp build/circuit_final.zkey . && cp build/verification_key.json .
scripts.full-setup: npm run compile && npm run setup:phase1 && npm run setup:phase2 && npm run setup:beacon && npm run export:vkey && npm run export:solidity && npm run copy:artifacts
